name: Devils in Westfall
summary: Dust devils roam Westfall, and Collin Mauren needs their remains for a spell. The Mage Quarter wizard is helping Gaxim Rustfizzle with an unusual experiment. Their work calls for a messaging scroll, and the dust holds what Mauren needs to enchant it.

sections.title: A Messenger's Components
sections.body: Collin Mauren is preparing a messaging scroll for Gaxim Rustfizzle. The wizard is helping the tinkerer with an unusual venture, but the spell needs more than ink and vellum. Dust devils roam Westfall with elemental magic swirling within them. Their remains provide the volatile medium Mauren needs to bind Gaxim's spell to parchment.

sections.title: The Elemental Wastes
sections.body: Westfall was once Stormwind's fertile breadbasket. Drought, banditry, and neglect have left its fields arid and wild. Dust devils roam there, threatening travelers and lone homesteaders. Their residue holds the focused elemental essence Mauren needs to complete the enchantment.

faq.answer: Collin Mauren is a human mage in Stormwind's Mage Quarter. He works with spellcasters in the city and sometimes helps outside researchers such as Gaxim Rustfizzle prepare enchanted scrolls and arcane components.

faq.q: Why does Collin Mauren need dust devil debris?
aliases: what is dust devil debris for
faq.answer: Collin Mauren needs dust devil debris to enchant a messaging scroll for Gaxim Rustfizzle. The remains hold elemental energy that helps bind the spell to parchment.
Dust devils roam Westfall's dry plains and barren fields, especially the dusty stretches between neglected farmsteads south of the Sentinel Hill road.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is an ambitious gnome inventor working on esoteric engineering projects. Collin Mauren helps him prepare enchanted scrolls for his experiments.

faq.q: What happens after bringing the debris to Mauren?
faq.answer: With the debris, Collin Mauren completes the messaging scroll and asks you to take it to Gaxim Rustfizzle, so the inventor can continue his experiments.

faq.q: Are dust devils magical or natural creatures?
faq.answer: Dust devils are minor air elementals that appear as living whirlwinds of sand and grit. They thrive in Westfall's dry, unsettled landscape.

angles.text: As a mage, you see how enchanting can harness wild elemental resonance to bind a complex communication spell into a scroll.
As an engineer, you see Gaxim Rustfizzle's work draw on arcane scrollcraft to solve a communication problem.
As an Alliance traveler, you cross from Stormwind's towers to Westfall's neglected fields, where the kingdom's frontier lies in ruin.
